title: The Half-Light Undertow
author: Sable Fairweather
blurb: Felix Eriksen, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
